lines.zh: 八条腿在沼泽里也嫌少。
lines.en: Eight legs feel too few in this swamp.
Something moves under the rotting leaves.
Muddy water is surging my way.
The wind of undergrowth pushes me.

lines.zh: 这条苇丛小路，我走熟了。
lines.en: I know this reed path by heart.
A frog underfoot; I step around it.

lines.zh: 须毛先探到前面的软泥。
lines.en: My bristles feel the soft mud ahead.

lines.zh: 落叶盖住了我常走的路。
lines.en: Fallen leaves have buried my usual path.
Following the water marks, I find my nest.
Swamp silk is stickier than most.

lines.zh: 沼泥灌进我的关节里了。
lines.en: Swamp mud has worked into my joints.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，全粘在我腿上。
lines.en: Swamp mud clings to all my legs.

lines.zh: 泥里那串脚印，是昨天的我。
lines.en: That trail of prints is mine from yesterday.
My web hangs on the reeds.
Past these reeds lies my nest.

lines.zh: 八条腿陷在沼泥里，拔不快。
lines.en: Eight legs stuck in the mire — I can't pull free quickly.
Hanging from a reed saves strength.
I keep fermented spider eyes for later.
Eight legs take turns resting, and I am still tired.

lines.zh: 那声音是我磨牙，不是脚步。
lines.en: That rasp is my fangs, not footsteps.
I count the dew on my web.
I can hear my silk trembling.

lines.zh: 沼泽的湿气，让我的网更黏。
lines.en: The swamp damp makes my web stickier.

lines.zh: 八只眼，闭上四只也够看。
lines.en: Eight eyes; four shut still leaves me watching.

lines.zh: 我在等一只粗心的蚊子。
lines.en: I am waiting for a careless mosquito.
The wind died; my web stops swaying.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，我结了三层网。
lines.en: Three webs deep in the swamp dungeon.

lines.zh: 枯叶卷起来，像我收着腿。
lines.en: A curled dead leaf, like me with my legs tucked.
You stand taller than my whole web.
Keep your boot tip away from my web.
I web in the swamp reeds.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，我八只脚都陷进去。
lines.en: Swamp mud swallows all eight of my feet.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛，全落在你身上。
lines.en: All eight eyes rest on you.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛都看见你踩进沼泽。
lines.en: All eight eyes saw you step into the swamp.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我在网里闻过。
lines.en: I have smelled you in my web before.

lines.zh: 沼泽的丝，比普通蛛网更黏。
lines.en: Swamp silk is stickier than the usual web.

lines.zh: 蛛丝横在水草间，别绊倒。
lines.en: My web spans the reeds; don't trip.

lines.zh: 你踩断了芦苇，我听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a reed. I heard it.
A chip has broken off my shell's rim.
My thin legs won't hold steady.
My silk sac throbs.
I will spin a web across your path.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳被敲出一声闷响。
lines.en: My shell gives off a dull crack.

lines.zh: 这点伤，沼泽会替我盖住。
lines.en: The swamp will cover this little wound.

lines.zh: 毒液回流到我自己的腿里。
lines.en: Venom has backed into my own legs.

lines.zh: 蛛丝断了一根，还有七根。
lines.en: One thread snapped; seven still hold.
My silk's gone — I'll have to weave again.

lines.zh: 沼泽的丝，比普通蛛丝更韧。
lines.en: Swamp silk is tougher than ordinary web.

lines.zh: 我的丝挂在芦苇上，别扯。
lines.en: My silk hangs on the reeds, do not pull.
Sweetness mixed in with the wet leaves.
Can I drag this into the dungeon?
This is not a trap, is it?

lines.zh: 叶子！我闻到湿叶子的味了。
lines.en: Leaves! I smell wet leaves.
I test it first with my bristles.
Nectar is smeared between your fingers.
My front legs reach out on their own.
Smells like a bug. A live one.
It glimmers, and I cannot move on.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的网，挂在芦苇上。
lines.en: My web hangs on the reeds.
You bent one of my bristles.
Your greaves are harder than bark.
You knocked apart the silk I just spun.
My silk is sticking to your boot sole.

lines.zh: 你踩得我八只脚都乱了。
lines.en: You have scrambled all eight of my legs.

lines.zh: 沼泽的丝，比地面的水还黏。
lines.en: Swamp silk is stickier than the water.
You broke my web.
You kicked my abdomen.
Eight legs, and you stepped on two.

lines.zh: 你身上有雨后沼泽的味道。
lines.en: You smell of the swamp after rain.

lines.zh: 这张网，我织了三个晚上。
lines.en: I spun this web over three nights.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，我认得出你。
lines.en: In the swamp fog, I know you.
Your web is unusual, truly.

lines.zh: 地牢里那块干草，够我们住。
lines.en: That dry patch in the dungeon is room enough.

lines.zh: 这张网结在芦苇上，结实。
lines.en: This web, strung on the reeds, is strong.

lines.zh: 卵囊里会有几百只小蜘蛛。
lines.en: The egg sac will hold hundreds of little ones.

lines.zh: 我把前足抬起来给你看。
lines.en: I lift my front legs to show you.
The swamp is damp. Good for webs.
My fangs are sheathed. I will not touch you.
There is hardly room left in the nest.
A shard of shell that catches the light.
Swamp silk is stickier than most

lines.zh: 这个垫在卵囊底下正好。
lines.en: This will line the egg sac nicely.
A fermented spider eye, saved for later.
If I can drag it, I drag it home.
This string is enough to patch a web.
Who left this half-eaten bug?
Do not take it. That silk is mine.
You have stepped into the heart of my web.
Stay still; the silk tightens by itself.
I count to two, then you run.

lines.zh: 丝线已经缠在你脚上了。
lines.en: My silk is already on your ankles.
Wet silk, still sticky.

lines.zh: 我闻到你害怕的味道了。
lines.en: I smell the fear on you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的八只眼，全跟着你。
lines.en: Eight swamp eyes track you.
I spin my web through the swamp mud.
One step from you and the silk pulls taut.
This prey belongs to my web.
Your neck fits one bite.

lines.zh: 湿丝已经圈住你的脚踝。
lines.en: Wet silk is already around your ankle.

lines.zh: 这张网，我守到天亮也行。
lines.en: I can guard this web until dawn.

lines.zh: 你踩得满脚是泥，跑不快。
lines.en: Your feet are caked in mud; you cannot run.
Struggle more and the silk bites into flesh.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水声，盖住了我的脚。
lines.en: Swamp water hides the sound of my steps.

lines.zh: 发酵蛛眼，我肚子里就有。
lines.en: Fermented spider eyes — I keep them inside.
Fermented spider eyes. I carry some.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，你甩不掉。
lines.en: With all eight legs moving, you cannot lose me.
The pool blocks you; there is no way around.
You have broken three of my threads.

lines.zh: 石头后面，我照样摸得到。
lines.en: Even behind stone, I can feel you.
I have already circled ahead of you.
Wherever you turn, the silk follows.

lines.zh: 沼泽的丝比林地的更黏。
lines.en: Swamp silk is stickier than forest silk.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么大，网结在哪都行。
lines.en: The swamp is big — I can spin anywhere.
My fangs graze the top of your foot.
Back off — want another bite?
One bite from me and your legs go weak.
Swamp silk has caught your feet.

lines.zh: 窸窣一声，正咬在你脖子上。
lines.en: A rustle — and my fangs find your neck.
Venom still hangs from my fangs.
This is my second bite.
I'll leave you a fermented spider eye.

lines.zh: 发酵的蛛眼，我留着有用。
lines.en: I keep the fermented spider eye.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么湿，丝都不黏了。
lines.en: So damp here, my silk will not stick.

lines.zh: 沼泽里爬出来，八只眼都湿。
lines.en: Out of the swamp, all eight eyes wet.
Swamp air is thick and sticky.
Three days hungry, and one finally came.
My eight eyes will not open yet.
My web is not spun and someone is already here.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我先动一条腿。
lines.en: In the swamp mud, I move one leg first.

lines.zh: 这窝里，还有别的蜘蛛吗？
lines.en: Any others in this nest?
Is this undergrowth?

lines.zh: 火把我腿上的毛燎没了！
lines.en: The fire burned the hair right off my legs!
My wet silk snapped as I fell.
Water is pouring into my spiracles!
The blast overturned my web.
My silk sac leaks onto the ground.
Eight legs gone weak. Can't move.
Too few bugs in the dungeon. I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷劈在苇丛，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the reeds and numbed me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有芦苇，我结不成网。
lines.en: No reeds in the void; I cannot spin.
